INF = 1000000000;\nconstexpr unsigned int MAX_DISTANCE = 200;\n\n// Index calculation for flattened 2D array\ninline constexpr size_t idx2(const size_t i, const size_t j, const size_t n) noexcept {\n    return j * n + i;\n}\n\nvoid initializeDistanceMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes, \n                              const unsigned int rangeMin, const unsigned int rangeMax) {\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    const double range = static_cast<double>(rangeMax - rangeMin) + 1.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes * numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[i] = rangeMin + (unsigned int)(range * rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX);\n    }\n    \n    // Set diagonal to zero (distance from node to itself is 0)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] = 0;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid initializePathMatrix(std::vector<unsigned int>& path, const size_t numNodes) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, \n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path, \n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Classic Floyd-Warshall algorithm\n    // For each intermediate node k\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n        // For each source node i\n        for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            // For each destination node j\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < numNodes; ++j) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                const unsigned int newDist = distIK + distKJ;\n                \n                if (newDist < distIJ) {\n                    dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = newDist;\n                    path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = k;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n    \n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n                \n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\", \n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numNodes = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Shortest Path Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrices\n    std::vector<unsigned int> dist(numNodes * numNodes);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> path(numNodes * numNodes);\n    \n    // Initialize\n    printf(\"Initializing graph...\\n\");\n    initializeDistanceMatrix(dist, numNodes, 1, MAX_DISTANCE);\n    initializePathMatrix(path, numNodes);\n    \n    // Run Floyd-Warshall\n    printf(\"Computing shortest paths...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    floydWarshall(dist, path, numNodes);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate operations per second\n    // Floyd-Warshall has O(n³) complexity\n    double ops = (double)numNodes * numNodes * numNodes;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation (integer hash-based)\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results_int(dist, \"DistanceMatrix\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateResult(dist, numNodes);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: r < TILE; r += THREADS_Y) {\n        tile[r][tx] = dist[origin + static_cast<size_t>(r) * np + tx];\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    for (int kk = 0; kk < TILE; ++kk) {\n        for (int r = ty; r < TILE; r += THREADS_Y) {\n            // Column kk (threads with tx == kk) and row kk (threads with r == kk)\n            // do not change during step kk, so these reads are the step-kk values\n            if (tx == kk) {\n                pivotSnap[r * TILE + kk] = tile[r][tx];\n            }\n            if (r == kk) {\n                pivotSnap[TILE * TILE + kk * TILE + tx] = tile[r][tx];\n            }\n\n            const unsigned int newDist = tile[r][kk] + tile[kk][tx];\n            if (newDist < tile[r][tx]) {\n                tile[r][tx] = newDist;\n                path[origin + static_cast<size_t>(r) * np + tx] = b * TILE + kk;\n            }\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n\n    for (int r = ty; r < TILE; r += THREADS_Y) {\n        dist[tileOrigin + static_cast<size_t>(r) * np + tx] = tile[r][tx];\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 3: relax all remaining tiles (i, j) with i != b and j != b.\n// Each tile reads the step-wise pivot snapshots from shared memory, and\n// keeps its own values in registers across the k loop.\n__global__ void fwPhase3(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path, const unsigned int* colSnap,\n                         const unsigned int* rowSnap, const int np, const int b) {\n    __shared__ unsigned int colTile[TILE][TILE]; q < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++q) {\n        const int r = ty + q * THREADS_Y;\n        dist[cOrigin + static_cast<size_t>(r) * np + tx] = cur[q];\n        path[cOrigin + static_cast<size_t>(r) * np + tx] = curPath[q];\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    if (numNodes == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Pad to a whole number of tiles. i < numNodes; ++i) {\n            path[idx2(i, j, numNodes)] = j;\n            path[idx2(j, i, numNodes)] = i;\n        }\n        path[idx2(j, j, numNodes)] = j;\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 1: relax the pivot tile (b, b) using only its own nodes.\n// Row k and column k of the tile do not change during iteration k because the\n// diagonal is zero, so the in-place update within a tile matches classic FW.\n__global__ void fwPhase1(unsigned int* dist, unsigned int* path, const int np, const int b) {\n    __shared__ unsigned int tile[TILE][TILE];\n\n    const int tx = threadIdx.x;\n    const int ty = threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t origin = static_cast<size_t>(b) * TILE * np + static_cast<size_t>(b) * TILE;\n\n    for (int r = ty; r < TILE; r += THREADS_Y) {\n        dist[origin + static_cast<size_t>(r) * np + tx] = tile[r][tx];\n    }\n}\n\n// Phase 2: relax the tiles that share the pivot block's row (b, t) or column (t, b).\n// blockIdx.x enumerates t over all blocks except b; kk < TILE; ++kk) {\n        for (int q = 0; q < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++q) {\n            const int r = ty + q * THREADS_Y;\n            const unsigned int newDist = colTile[r][kk] + rowTile[kk][tx];\n            if (newDist < cur[q]) {\n                cur[q] = newDist;\n                curPath[q] = b * TILE + kk;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    for (int q = 0; q < ROWS_PER_THREAD; ++q) {\n        const int r = ty + q * THREADS_Y;\n        dist[cOrigin + static_cast<size_t>(r) * np + tx] = cur[q];\n        path[cOrigin + static_cast<size_t>(r) * np + tx] = curPath[q];\n    }\n}\n\nvoid floydWarshall(std::vector<unsigned int>& dist,\n                   std::vector<unsigned int>& path,\n                   const size_t numNodes) {\n    if (numNodes == 0) {\n        return;\n    }\n\n    // Pad to a whole number of tiles. Padding nodes have INF distance to every\n    // other node and zero distance to themselves, so no real path can go through them.\n    const size_t numTiles = (numNodes + TILE - 1) / TILE;\n    const size_t paddedN = numTiles * TILE;\n\n    std::vector<unsigned int> hostDist(paddedN * paddedN, INF);\n    std::vector<unsigned int> hostPath(paddedN * paddedN, 0);\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < paddedN; ++i) {\n        hostDist[i * paddedN + i] = 0;\n    }\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        std::copy_n(&dist[i * numNodes], numNodes, &hostDist[i * paddedN]);\n        std::copy_n(&path[i * numNodes], numNodes, &hostPath[i * paddedN]);\n    }\n\n    const size_t bytes = paddedN * paddedN * sizeof(unsigned int);\n    unsigned int* dDist = nullptr;\n    unsigned int* dPath = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dDist, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&dPath, bytes));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dDist, hostDist.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(dPath, hostPath.data(), bytes, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    const int np = static_cast<int>(paddedN);\n    const int nb = static_cast<int>(numTiles);\n    const dim3 block(THREADS_X, THREADS_Y);\n\n    // Rounds over pivot blocks; each round must finish before the next starts\n    for (int b = 0; b < nb; ++b) {\n        fwPhase1<<<1, block>>>(dDist, dPath, np, b);\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        if (nb > 1) {\n            fwPhase2<<<dim3(nb - 1, 2), block>>>(dDist, dPath, np, b);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n            fwPhase3<<<dim3(nb - 1, nb - 1), block>>>(dDist, dPath, np, b);\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n        }\n    }\n\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostDist.data(), dDist, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(hostPath.data(), dPath, bytes, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dDist));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(dPath));\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        std::copy_n(&hostDist[i * paddedN], numNodes, &dist[i * numNodes]);\n        std::copy_n(&hostPath[i * paddedN], numNodes, &path[i * numNodes]);\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<unsigned int>& dist, const size_t numNodes) {\n    // Basic sanity checks\n\n    // 1. Diagonal should be zero\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < numNodes; ++i) {\n        if (dist[idx2(i, i, numNodes)] != 0) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: diagonal element [%zu,%zu] is not zero\\n\", i, i);\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // 2. Triangle inequality: dist[i][k] + dist[k][j] >= dist[i][j]\n    // Check a sample of paths to avoid O(n^3) validation time\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < std::min(numNodes, static_cast<size_t>(10)); ++j) {\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < numNodes; ++k) {\n                const unsigned int distIJ = dist[idx2(j, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distIK = dist[idx2(k, i, numNodes)];\n                const unsigned int distKJ = dist[idx2(j, k, numNodes)];\n\n                // Check for overflow before addition\n                if (distIK < INF && distKJ < INF) {\n                    if (distIK + distKJ < distIJ) {\n                        printf(\"Validation failed: triangle inequality violated at [%zu,%zu,%zu]\\n\",\n                               i, j, k);\n                        return false;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of nodes in the graph argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t numNodes = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if  printf(\"Number of nodes: %zu\\n\", numNodes);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n\n    initCudaDevice();\n\n    // Allocate matrices\n {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-haiku-5-5","id":"msg_011Cfy8sjoXMHCChE5h7rmqi","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The Floyd-Warshall benchmark now runs on the GPU unconditionally. Output matches the original CPU program exactly, and it is 33× to 306× faster on the RTX 3090 for n = 512 to 4096.\n\n| n | CPU (original) | GPU | Speedup |\n|---|---|---|---|\n| 512 | 165 ms | 5 ms | ~33× |\n| 1024 | 1226 ms | 17 ms | ~72× |\n| 2048 | 9382 ms | 58 ms | ~160× |\n| 4096 | 74049 ms | 242 ms | ~306× |\n\n**Changes**\n- **`floydwarshall/floydwarshall.cpp`**: The algorithm is a blocked Floyd-Warshall with 32×32 tiles in shared memory. Each pivot round runs three kernels: the pivot tile, then the pivot row and column tiles, then all remaining tiles. The non-kernel code (input generation, `-r` output, validation, argument parsing) is unchanged.\n- **`floydwarshall/CMakeLists.txt`**: Enables the CUDA language, compiles the same `.cpp` as CUDA, and sets `CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES native`. The executable is still `floydwarshall`.\n\n**Correctness checks**\n- I compared the distance and path matrices against the original code for n = 1, 2, 7, 31, 32, 33, 100, 129, 256, 300, 512, 1000, and 1537. Both match exactly.\n- The `-r` output matches the original for the same sizes, and `-v` reports PASSED.\n- Path matching needed extra work. The blocked order alone gave identical distances but different intermediate-node values for n ≥ 33. Each phase now records the pivot row and column as they stood at each step, and the final phase reads those records.\n\n**Choices you may want to revisit**\n- **Timed region**: The timer still wraps `floydWarshall`, so the GPU figures include the host-to-device and device-to-host copies and the device allocations. The CUDA context is created before the timer starts.\n- **Padding**: Matrices are padded to a multiple of 32 with unreachable nodes. These padding nodes never change a real distance or path.\n- **CMake minimum**: Raised from 3.10 to 3.24, which is required for `native` architectures.\n- **No fallback**: Without an NVIDIA GPU the program exits with a CUDA error, as you asked.\n\nThe repo is not a git repository and you didn't ask for a commit, so nothing is committed. My comparison harness and the original-source copy are in `/tmp`, outside the project."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":720,"cache_read_input_tokens":103797,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":720},"output_tokens":6,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"33fec2c6-e61d-4760-8761-4daaf66bd24a","uuid":"0ef7bc30-5540-4a24-a9e7-8d0d454e2afc","timestamp":"2026-10-12T22:32:02.683Z","request_id":"req_011Cfy8sjVRQxbWPVGCvk3MQ"}
